scheme.name: Shramik Parivahan Yojana (GBOCWWB)
scheme.summary: Registered construction workers are provided a bus pass through the Municipal Corporation at a concessional rate for commuting from Kadianaka to their workplace.
eligibility: The applicant must be engaged in building or other construction work.
The construction worker must be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.
scheme.benefits: Beneficiaries contribute 20% of the bus pass cost, while the board covers the remaining 80%.
scheme.how_to_apply: Visit the nearest municipal corporation office, collect and fill out the application form, attach required documents, and submit to the concerned official.
